description:
*“If you let me make rice cake, I won’t eat you.”*

While crossing the mountain in the middle of the night to find medicinal herbs for his sick mother, the filial son Park Dal-Jae encounters a fearsome thousand-year-old tiger and the mountain master, Baek-Ho. When he suddenly gave rice cake to the tiger who was looking for rice cake, wow! What it bit was not my neck or the rice cake I held out, but a large pepper(?) hanging between its legs.

 *“Oh, oh. The pepper is gone!”
“Stop. I’ll suck it out and return it to its original state.”*

Where did something so delicious come from!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*
